children: Motilal Oswal's research report on Mahindra Logistics

Mahindra Logistics’ (MLL) revenue grew ~24% YoY to ~INR21b in 2QFY27 (10% above our estimate). EBITDA margin was in line with our estimate and came in at 5.9% in 2QFY27 (up 90bp/10bp YoY/QoQ). EBITDA grew ~46% YoY to INR1.2b (10% above estimate). APAT stood at INR262m in 2QFY27 v/s adjusted net loss of INR104m in 2QFY26 (12% above our estimate). Supply chain management recorded revenue of INR19.7b (+24% YoY) and EBIT of ~INR358m. Enterprise Mobility Services (EMS) reported revenue of INR1.24b (+32% YoY) and EBIT of INR45.3m.
We forecast a revenue and EBITDA CAGR of 19% and 28%, respectively, over FY26-28, and reiterate our Neutral rating with a TP of INR400 (premised on 21x FY28E EPS).
